about: The one template the start dialog fills in, and the one tests/test_snippets.py runs. Placeholders are replaced with Python string literals (JSON string syntax, which Python reads unchanged).
template:
from ledgerlog import LedgerLog

with LedgerLog(
    {{directory}},
    fsync_policy={{fsync_policy}},
) as db:
    db.put(b"user:1042", b"hello")
    print(db.get(b"user:1042"))
